editorial.blurb: A hidden rooftop gem above Wicker Park with knockout city views, a refreshing pool, and solid tacos that shine at happy hour prices.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the $2 taco special between 11am–2pm, then ask for Leslie at the counter — she'll take great care of you. Arrive early on sunny days to snag a spot with skyline views before it gets crowded.
